start.topic: Perimeter of rectangles, squares and polygons

turns.reply: Kabir, picture ko words mein dekhiye: ek rectangle, do sides 50 m aur do sides 30 m. Sab sides jodne par kya milega?
Kabir, ab picture words mein sochiye: rectangle ki chaar sides hain—50 m, 30 m, 50 m, 30 m. Aap inhe jodkar boliye.
